title: Present
description: Affirmative, negative, question forms of be, present simple, present continuous, and possession.

title: Past
description: Past time forms of be (was/were), regular and irregular past simple, and past continuous.

title: Present Perfect
description: Present perfect for life experience, recent events with just/already/yet, duration, and past contrast.

title: Passive
description: Basic passive constructions in present simple, past simple, continuous, and perfect.

title: Verb Forms
description: Conjugation of primary verbs be/have/do and high-frequency irregular verb families.

title: Future
description: Expressing the future with present continuous arrangements, be going to plans, and will/shall.

title: Modals and Everyday Functions
description: Ability, obligation, advice, polite requests, imperatives, and past habits (used to).

title: There and It
description: Existential there is/are across tenses and placeholder dummy it for time, weather, and distance.

title: Auxiliary Verbs
description: Auxiliary verbs in short answers, agreement (too/either, so/neither), and negative contractions.

title: Questions
description: Question word order, question words, subject vs object questions, and indirect questions.

title: Reported Speech
description: Reporting statements using say and tell with basic tense adjustment.

title: -ing and to
description: Verb complementation with gerunds (-ing) and to-infinitives, plus infinitive of purpose.

title: Common Verb Patterns
description: Everyday usage and idiomatic combinations with go, get, do, make, and have.

title: Pronouns and Possessives
description: Subject, object, and possessive pronouns, reflexive pronouns, and possessive 's.

title: Articles and Nouns
description: Indefinite and definite articles (a/an, the), countable/uncountable nouns, and zero article.

title: Determiners and Pronouns
description: Demonstratives, indefinite pronouns, quantifiers (some, any, every, all, both, much, many, few).

title: Adjectives and Adverbs
description: Adjective positions, adverbs of manner (-ly), comparatives (-er/more), superlatives, too, and enough.

title: Word Order
description: Standard declarative order (SVO + Place + Time), adverb placement, and double objects.

title: Conjunctions and Clauses
description: Coordinating connectives, time clauses (when), basic conditional sentences (if), and relative clauses.

title: Prepositions
description: Prepositions of time, location, movement, and dependent collocations with adjectives and verbs.

title: Phrasal Verbs
description: Essential two-part verbs, movement particles, and separable pronoun placement.

title: Beginner Final Challenge
description: Comprehensive diagnostic review and mastery assessment synthesizing all A1–A2 grammar concepts.
